messages.author: 77ed1f09d3d5af9c
messages.subject: Trouble loading dartR
parts:
Hello,

I am running R-4.0.2.

I was using dartR successfully 18 months ago when I wrote my thesis. Now, I want to rerun some of the analyses. I am not successful.

To try to sort out my problem I have used

        sessionInfo()

The base packages are attached. Then used:

        install.packages("dartR", dependencies = TRUE)

 And get

        package ‘dartR’ successfully unpacked and MD5 sums checked

 

The downloaded binary packages are in

        C:\Users\user\AppData\Local\Temp\RtmpofFsr9\downloaded_packages

Then:

        > ## to test the package has loaded properly

> gl.plot(testset.gl)

Error in gl.plot(testset.gl) : could not find function "gl.plot"

Any suggestions please?

Thanks,

Ruth
